messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 Paging — SmartRouting detected unstable fallback loop for customer="LedgerCo" in region=eu-central-1. Elevated 5xx and latency spikes since 02:12 UTC. Pager to oncall.

maria: oncall here. assigning to oliver for initial triage. @oliver can you take?

oliver: taking. quick summary pls — is this policy-engine level or runner errors?

sam: logs show alternating decisions: policy marks quant variant as incompatible for tool-calls, routes to fp16 in us-west-2, remote rejects because of context_limit mismatch, then policy tries original again. loop period ~15s per session.

rachel-cs: LedgerCo has flagged failed payments calls and webhook timeouts. They've throttled some traffic but still seeing errors. Requesting ETA and status.

oliver: priority: (A) break loop, (B) reduce customer impact, (C) find root cause. Proposing immediate disable of cross-region fallback for LedgerCo via policy override.

maria: agree. oliver, can you flip a customer-scoped rule quickly?

oliver: executing emergency toggle: `POST /console/policies/overrides` body: `{ "customer": "ledgerco", "fallback": false }`

deploy-bot: rollout started: policy-override/ledgerco-no-fallback/2178976543

monitoring-bot: smart-routing.loop-rate[ledgerco]=70 -> 3 (post-toggle), median_p95_latency=1.8s -> 240ms

oliver: loop rate dropped immediately. good. we'll keep fallback disabled while debugging.

sam: digging into model compatibility records — looking at model-compat-table entries for `redwood-6b-q4` (quant) and `redwood-6b-fp16`.

sam: found entry: `redwood-6b-q4: { tool_call_support: false, max_context: 4096 }` but actual manifest for deployed quant binary indicates `tool_call: true` and `max_context: 8192`.

oliver: so onboarding metadata is wrong. policy thinks quant can't do tool calling => forces fallback to fp16 in other region.

sam: exact error trace from policy-engine: `CompatCheckError(variant=redwood-6b-q4, missing=tool_call) -> choose variant=redwood-6b-fp16@us-west-2 -> RemoteError(incompatible_context)`. Loop repeats.

rachel-cs: LedgerCo impact: spike in failed transactions, some duplicate requests visible. They've requested postmortem and will need timeline.

maria: immediate mitigations: (1) keep customer fallback disabled, (2) patch compat-table entry to reflect true capabilities, (3) invalidate policy-engine cache. We'll stage changes carefully.

oliver: applying compat-table patch now via models-api: `PATCH /models/compat/redwood-6b-q4` payload: `{ "tool_call_support": true, "max_context": 8192 }`

deploy-bot: models-api/compat-patch started: job=patch-7711

deploy-bot: models-api/compat-patch succeeded: job=patch-7711

sam: cache invalidation request to policy-engine: `POST /policy/cache/invalidate?model=redwood-6b-q4` -> acknowledged.

monitoring-bot: policy-compat-check.failures[ledgerco] -> 0; smart-routing.loop-rate -> 0; p95 latency -> 210ms

oliver: canary plan: keep override for 10m, then enable fallback for 2% sessions, ramp to 25% if stable. Maria, can you coordinate the canary?

maria: starting canary at 02:38 UTC with 2%.

monitoring-bot: ledgerco-route-health: error_rate 0.3% (pre-mitig 5.1%), median_latency 220ms

rachel-cs: LedgerCo confirms improvements, but wants full RCA and mitigation steps. Scheduling follow-up call for tomorrow.

sam: root cause notes: onboarding job `model-onboarder` incorrectly mapped `capabilities.tool_call` from nested manifest path `capabilities.features.tool_call` vs expected `capabilities.tool_call` when quantized artifacts were uploaded by infra team. Regression introduced by deploy 2026-03-10.

oliver: short-term fixes: (A) update compat entry (done), (B) keep customer-scoped fallback disabled until postmortem complete, (C) add integration test to model-onboarder to verify tool_call and max_context fields.

maria: long-term: add auditing job that cross-checks matrix entries against model manifests every 6 hours and alert on mismatches; add traffic-safe fallback policy that prevents oscillation between regions by enforcing cooldowns.

sam: filing follow-up tickets: onboarder unit test, manifest-audit job, emergency no-fallback toggle in Console. I'll own the onboarder test ticket.

monitoring-bot: policy-override/ledgerco-no-fallback scheduled removal canceled per maria request.

maria: handing off incident to sam for postmortem write-up. I'll remain available for questions.

sam: taking postmortem. TTR (time-to-mitigate): 26m from initial pager. Marking incident SEV2 -> mitigated at 02:38 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated, severity=SEV2, owner=sam, time_to_mitigate=26m

rachel-cs: postmortem draft will be shared and customer-facing RCA prepared. Thanks everyone.

maria: closing on-call shift notes. Please attach any logs or request IDs to the postmortem thread.

oliver: added example request IDs and raw policy-engine traces to the postmortem doc.

sam: good job team. :thumbsup:
